metadata.title: The local logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality for bodies of revolution

nodes.name: Convex body
nodes.statement: $\Kc(\R^n)$ denotes the set of compact convex sets in $\R^n$, called convex bodies.

nodes.name: Minkowski addition
nodes.statement: For $a,b \geq 0$ and sets $K,L$ in $\R^n$, $aK+bL=\{ax+by:x\in K,y\in L\}$.

nodes.name: Support function
nodes.statement: For $K\in\Kc(\R^n)$, $h_K(x)=\max_{y\in K}\langle x,y\rangle$, viewed as a function on $S^{n-1}$ or as a $1$-homogeneous function on $\R^n$.

nodes.name: Geometric mean body $K^tL^{1-t}$ (Wulff shape)
nodes.statement: For $K,L$ containing origin in interior, $K^tL^{1-t}=\bigcap_{x\in S^{n-1}}\{z\in\R^n:\langle x,z\rangle\leq h_K(x)^th_L(x)^{1-t}\}$.

nodes.name: Origin symmetric convex bodies $\Kc_e(\R^n)$
nodes.statement: $K\in\Kc(\R^n)$ is origin symmetric if $K=-K$; $\Kc_e(\R^n)$ denotes origin-symmetric bodies containing origin in their interior.

nodes.name: $L^p$-convex combination
nodes.statement: For $p\neq 0$, $tK+_p(1-t)L=\bigcap_{x\in S^{n-1}}\{z\in\R^n:\langle x,z\rangle\leq (th_K(x)^p+(1-t)h_L(x)^p)^{1/p}\}$.

nodes.name: Mixed discriminant $D$
nodes.statement: Symmetric multilinear extension of the determinant: $\det(\sum_i\lambda_iA_i)=\sum D(A_{i_1},\dots,A_{i_{n-1}})\lambda_{i_1}\cdots\lambda_{i_{n-1}}$.

nodes.name: Mixed volume $V$
nodes.statement: Symmetric multilinear functional $V:\Kc(\R^n)^n\to\R$ with $\vol(\sum_i\lambda_iK_i)=\sum V(K_{i_1},\dots,K_{i_n})\lambda_{i_1}\cdots\lambda_{i_n}$ for $\lambda_i\geq 0$.

nodes.name: Mixed area measure $S_{C_1,\dots,C_{n-1}}$
nodes.statement: Unique Borel measure on $S^{n-1}$ with $V(f,C_1,\dots,C_{n-1})=\frac{1}{n}\int_{S^{n-1}}f\,dS_{C_1,\dots,C_{n-1}}$ for differences of support functions $f$. Surface area measure: $S_K=S_{K,\dots,K}$.

nodes.name: Class $C^2_+$
nodes.statement: $K\in\Kc(\R^n)$ is of class $C^2_+$ if $h_K\in C^2(S^{n-1})$ and $D^2h_K>0$.

nodes.name: Measure $\mu_K$ on $S^{n-1}$
nodes.statement: For $K$ of class $C^2_+$ with origin in interior, $d\mu_K=\frac{1}{nh_K}dS_K=\frac{1}{nh_K}\det(D^2h_K)d\mathcal{H}^{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Elliptic operator $\mathcal{D}_K$
nodes.statement: For $f\in C^2(S^{n-1})$, $\mathcal{D}_Kf=h_K\frac{D(D^2f,D^2h_K[n-2])}{\det(D^2h_K)}$; extends to a uniformly elliptic symmetric self-adjoint operator on $L^2(S^{n-1},\mu_K)$.

nodes.name: Convex body of revolution
nodes.statement: Convex body symmetric under rotations around a fixed axis (here the $x_n$-axis); has support function $h_K(x)=\eta(x_n)$ for some $\eta\in C^2[-1,1]$.

nodes.name: Operators $\mathcal{A}_1,\mathcal{A}_2$
nodes.statement: For $\eta\in C^2[-1,1]$: $\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)=-t\eta'(t)+\eta(t)$ and $\mathcal{A}_2\eta(t)=(1-t^2)\eta''(t)+\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)$.

nodes.name: Spherical harmonics $\mathcal{H}_m^n$
nodes.statement: Space of restrictions to $S^{n-1}$ of $m$-homogeneous harmonic polynomials on $\R^n$.

nodes.name: Weight $w_{m,n}(t)$
nodes.statement: $w_{m,n}(t)=\frac{\mathcal{A}_2\eta(t)\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)^{n-2}}{n\eta(t)}(1-t^2)^{m+\frac{n-3}{2}}$.

nodes.name: Isotypical decomposition spaces $E_m$
nodes.statement: $E_m=\mathcal{H}_m^{n-1}\otimes L^2([-1,1],w_{m,n}(t)dt)$, with the indicated tensor inner product.

nodes.name: Operator $\mathcal{D}_m$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{D}_m=\mathcal{D}_K|_{E_m}$, the restriction of $\mathcal{D}_K$ to the isotypical component $E_m$.

nodes.name: Sturm-Liouville operator $L_m$ and coefficient $k_m$
nodes.statement: $L_m\overline{f}(t)=\frac{\eta(t)}{(n-1)\mathcal{A}_2\eta(t)\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)^{n-2}(1-t^2)^{m+\frac{n-3}{2}}}\frac{d}{dt}\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)^{n-2}(1-t^2)^{m+\frac{n-1}{2}}\overline{f}'(t)+\frac{\eta(t)k_m(t)}{(n-1)\mathcal{A}_2\eta(t)\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)}\overline{f}(t)$ with $k_m(t)=-(m-1)(n-2)\mathcal{A}_2\eta(t)-(m^2-1)\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)-m(m-1)\eta''(t)$.

nodes.name: Weighted Sobolev space $H_m$
nodes.statement: $H_m=\{\overline{f}\in L^2([-1,1],(1-t^2)^{m+\frac{n-3}{2}}dt):\overline{f}'\in L^2([-1,1],(1-t^2)^{m+\frac{n-1}{2}}dt)\}$ with the natural Sobolev inner product.

nodes.name: Quantity $L_K(t)$
nodes.statement: $L_K(t)=\inf\{tp_n:p\in\partial K,\,(\sqrt{1-t^2}y,t)\text{ is normal to }K\text{ at }p\text{ for some }y\in S^{n-1}\}$. For $C^2_+$ bodies of revolution, $L_K(t)=t\int_0^t\mathcal{A}_2\eta(s)ds$.

nodes.name: Stability constants $c_m(K)$
nodes.statement: $c_1(K)=\frac{n-3}{n-1}+\frac{\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{x_n^2L_K(x_n)}{h_K(x)}dS_K}{\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{x_n^2}{h_K(x)}dS_K}$ and $c_m(K)=\frac{m(m+n-3)}{n-1}-1$ for $m\geq 2$. Strictly positive for origin-symmetric $K$ with $0$ in interior.

nodes.name: $\SO(n-1)$ symmetrization $\overline{L}$
nodes.statement: Convex body with $h_{\overline{L}}(x)=\int_{\SO(n-1)}h_L(g^{-1}x)dg$.

nodes.name: $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski problem
nodes.statement: Determine for which $p$, $K$, $L$, and $t\in[0,1]$ the inequality $\vol(tK+_p(1-t)L)^{p/n}\geq t\vol(K)^{p/n}+(1-t)\vol(L)^{p/n}$ holds.

nodes.name: Local $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski threshold for bodies of revolution ($p<0$)
nodes.statement: For any origin-symmetric convex body of revolution $K\subset\R^n$, determine if there is $p(K,n)<0$ such that the local $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski inequality holds for all $p\geq p(K,n)$ and all $L$ satisfying the centering condition.

nodes.name: Logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality
nodes.statement: For $K,L\in\Kc_e(\R^n)$ and $t\in[0,1]$, $\vol(K^tL^{1-t})\geq \vol(K)^t\vol(L)^{1-t}$.

nodes.name: Local $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski inequality
nodes.statement: For all $p\geq 0$ and $K,L\in\Kc_e(\R^n)$: $\frac{V(L,K[n-1])^2}{\vol(K)}\geq \frac{n-1}{n-p}V(L,L,K[n-2])+\frac{1-p}{n(n-p)}\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{h_L^2}{h_K}dS_K$.

nodes.name: Theorem A: Local log-BM for bodies of revolution
nodes.statement: If $K$ is an origin-symmetric convex body of revolution with nonempty interior and $L$ is any convex body with $\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{xh_L(x)}{h_K(x)}dS_K(x)=0$, then $(K,L)$ satisfies the local logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality.
assumptions: $K$ origin-symmetric convex body of revolution with nonempty interior

nodes.name: Theorem B: Equality cases
nodes.statement: Under the hypotheses of Theorem A, if additionally $\mathcal{H}^{n-1}$ is absolutely continuous with respect to $S_K$ on $S^{n-1}$, then equality in the local log-BM inequality forces $L$ to be a body of revolution.
conclusions: $L$ is a convex body of revolution

nodes.name: Spectral gap theorem for $\mathcal{D}_K$
nodes.statement: If $K$ is an origin-symmetric body of revolution, then any eigenvalue $\lambda\notin\{0,1\}$ of $\mathcal{D}_K$ satisfies $\lambda\leq -\frac{1}{n-1}$.
assumptions: $K$ origin-symmetric convex body of revolution of class $C^2_+$

nodes.name: Hessian of a zonal function
nodes.statement: For $\eta\in C^2[-1,1]$ and $h(x)=\eta(x_n)$: $D^2h(x)|_{T_xS^{n-1}}=\eta''(x_n)v(x)v(x)^T+\mathcal{A}_1\eta(x_n)\,\id$, where $v(x)=P_{x^\perp}e_n$.

nodes.name: Explicit form of $\mu_K$ and $\mathcal{D}_K$ for bodies of revolution
nodes.statement: For $K$ of revolution of class $C^2_+$ with $h_K(x)=\eta(x_n)$: $d\mu_K=\frac{\mathcal{A}_2\eta(x_n)\mathcal{A}_1\eta(x_n)^{n-2}}{n\eta(x_n)}d\mathcal{H}^{n-1}$ and $\mathcal{D}_Kf$ has the explicit divergence-form expression involving $\mathcal{A}_1\eta,\mathcal{A}_2\eta$.
assumptions: $K$ body of revolution of class $C^2_+$ with $h_K(x)=\eta(x_n)$

nodes.name: $L^p$ identity for products of zonal functions and spherical harmonics
nodes.statement: For $f_j(x)=\sum_i h_{i,j}(x_1,\dots,x_{n-1})\overline{f}_{i,j}(x_n)$ with $\{h_{i,j}\}$ ON basis of $\mathcal{H}_m^{n-1}$: $\int_{S^{n-1}}f_1f_2\,d\mu_K=\sum_i\int_{-1}^1 w_{m,n}(t)\overline{f}_{i,1}(t)\overline{f}_{i,2}(t)dt$.

nodes.name: Boundary regularity of zonal-spherical-harmonic factors
nodes.statement: For $f=\sum_i h_i\overline{f}_i\in C^2(S^{n-1})$ with $h_i\in\mathcal{H}_m^{n-1}$ and $m>0$, each $\overline{f}_i\in C^2(-1,1)$ and satisfies the Dirichlet ($\limsup(1-t^2)^{(m-1)/2}|\overline{f}_i(t)|<\infty$) and Neumann ($\limsup(1-t^2)^{(m+1)/2}|\overline{f}_i'(t)|<\infty$) boundary conditions.

nodes.name: Explicit form of $\mathcal{D}_m$ via Sturm-Liouville $L_m$
nodes.statement: For $\overline{f}\in C^2(-1,1)$ and $h\in\mathcal{H}_m^{n-1}$: $\mathcal{D}_m(h\otimes\overline{f})=h\otimes L_m\overline{f}$ on $S^{n-1}\setminus\{\pm e_n\}$, where $L_m$ is the Sturm-Liouville operator of Definition $L_m$.

nodes.name: Compact embedding $H_m\hookrightarrow L^2(w_{m,n})$
nodes.statement: For all $m\in\N_0$: (i) $C^2[-1,1]$ is dense in $H_m$; (ii) for $m\geq 1$, $\lim_{t\to\pm 1}(1-t^2)^{m+(n-3)/2}\overline{f}(t)^2=0$; (iii) $H_m$ embeds compactly in $L^2([-1,1],w_{m,n}(t)dt)$.

nodes.name: Even case spectral inequality on $E_0$
nodes.statement: For any even $\overline{f}\in H_0$ with $\langle\overline{f},\eta\rangle_{0,n}=0$ and Neumann boundary conditions: $\langle L_0\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{0,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{0,n}\leq 0$.

nodes.name: Single-eigenfunction lemma (Frobenius/Sturm-Liouville)
nodes.statement: Assume $\eta$ analytic and $m\in\N_0$. For any $\lambda\in\R$, there is at most a one-dimensional family of weak solutions in $H_m$ to $L_m\overline{f}=\lambda\overline{f}$ with the Neumann boundary conditions.

nodes.name: Reduction $L_m \leftrightarrow L_0$ via $\overline{g}=(1-t^2)^{m/2}\overline{f}$
nodes.statement: If $\overline{f}\in H_m$ satisfies the Neumann BCs, then $\overline{g}(t)=(1-t^2)^{m/2}\overline{f}(t)\in H_0$ satisfies (\ref{boundary_conditions_m=0}) and $\langle L_m\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}=\langle L_0\overline{g},\overline{g}\rangle_{0,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{g},\overline{g}\rangle_{0,n}-\frac{m(m+n-3)}{n(n-1)}\int_{-1}^1\mathcal{A}_2\eta\,\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-3}(1-t^2)^{m+(n-5)/2}\overline{f}^2dt$.

nodes.name: Odd-case bound on $E_1$
nodes.statement: For odd $\overline{f}\in H_1$ satisfying the Neumann BCs (with $m=1$), $\langle L_1\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{1,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{1,n}$ is bounded by an explicit Cauchy-Schwarz-type quantity (Lemma 4.13 in the paper).

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for the odd case ($m=1$)
nodes.statement: For $n\geq 3$ and $0\neq\overline{f}\in L^2([-1,1],w_{1,n}(t)dt)$: $(\int_{-1}^1\frac{\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}}{\eta}(1-t^2)^{(n-2)/2}t\overline{f}\,dt)^2\leq (n-2)(\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-3}(1-t^2)^{(n-3)/2}\overline{f}^2dt)(\int\frac{\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}}{\eta}(1-t^2)^{(n-3)/2}t^2dt)$.

nodes.name: Even-case bound on $E_m$ for $m\geq 2$
nodes.statement: For even $\overline{f}\in H_m$ with the Neumann BCs, $\langle L_m\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}$ is bounded by an explicit Cauchy-Schwarz-type quantity minus a stability term.

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for the even case ($m\geq 2$)
nodes.statement: For $m\geq 2$ and $0\neq\overline{f}\in L^2([-1,1],w_{m,n}(t)dt)$: $(\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}(1-t^2)^{m/2+(n-3)/2}\overline{f}\,dt)^2\leq \frac{m(m+n-3)}{n}(\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-3}(1-t^2)^{m+(n-5)/2}\overline{f}^2dt)(\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}\eta(1-t^2)^{(n-3)/2}dt)$.

nodes.name: Spectral inequality on $E_0$ for even eigenfunctions
nodes.statement: For all even $f\in E_0\cap C^2(S^{n-1})$ with $\langle f,h_K\rangle=0$: $\langle\mathcal{D}_0f,f\rangle+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle f,f\rangle\leq 0$. Equivalently: largest even eigenvalue is $1$ (eigenfunction $h_K$); any other even eigenvalue is $\leq -\frac{1}{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Full $E_0$ spectral inequality (homotopy argument)
nodes.statement: For all $\overline{f}\in H_0$ with $\langle\overline{f},\eta\rangle_{0,n}=\langle\overline{f},t\rangle_{0,n}=0$ and Neumann BCs: $\langle L_0\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{0,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{0,n}\leq 0$. Hence any eigenvalue $\lambda\notin\{0,1\}$ of $\mathcal{D}_0$ satisfies $\lambda\leq -\frac{1}{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Frobenius method for Fuchsian ODEs
nodes.statement: For $u''+\frac{p(z)}{z-z_0}u'+\frac{q(z)}{(z-z_0)^2}u=0$ with $p,q$ holomorphic, there exists a unique solution $u_1=(z-z_0)^{\alpha_1}h_1(z)$ with $h_1$ holomorphic, $h_1(z_0)=1$; if $\alpha_1-\alpha_2\notin\N_0$ a similar second solution exists, otherwise a logarithmic term may appear.
nodes.origin_citation: Teschl, Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems

nodes.name: Spectral inequality on $E_1$
nodes.statement: For all $\overline{f}\in H_1$ with the Neumann BCs ($m=1$) and $\langle\overline{f},1\rangle_{1,n}=0$: $\langle L_1\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{1,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{1,n}\leq 0$.

nodes.name: Spectral inequality on $E_m$ for $m\geq 2$
nodes.statement: For all $\overline{f}\in H_m$ ($m\geq 2$) with the Neumann BCs: $\langle L_m\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle_{m,n}\leq 0$.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue bound on $\mathcal{D}_m$ for $m\geq 1$
nodes.statement: For any $m\in\N$ and any eigenfunction $f$ of $\mathcal{D}_m$ with eigenvalue $\lambda$ that is orthogonal to linear functions: $\lambda\leq -\frac{1}{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Stronger local log-BM with stability terms
nodes.statement: For origin-symmetric body of revolution $K$ ($n\geq 3$) and $f\in C(S^{n-1})$ with $\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{xf(x)}{h_K(x)}dS_K=0$: $V(f,f,K[n-2])-\frac{n}{n-1}\frac{V(f,K[n-1])^2}{\vol(K)}+\frac{1}{n(n-1)}\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{f^2}{h_K}dS_K\leq -\frac{1}{n}\sum_{m=1}^\infty c_m(K)\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{(\pi_mf)^2}{h_K}dS_K$.
assumptions: $K$ origin-symmetric convex body of revolution with nonempty interior
$f\in C(S^{n-1})$ a difference of support functions
conclusions: The strengthened local log-BM inequality with stability terms (see statement)

nodes.name: Symmetrization corollary
nodes.statement: If $K$ is origin-symmetric of revolution, $p\geq -(n-1)\min\{c_1(K),c_2(K)\}$, and $L$ satisfies the centering condition, then if $(K,\overline{L})$ satisfies the local $L^p$-BM inequality, so does $(K,L)$, where $\overline{L}$ is the $\SO(n-1)$ symmetrization of $L$.

nodes.name: Brunn-Minkowski inequality (classical)
nodes.statement: For $K,L\in\Kc(\R^n)$ and $t\in[0,1]$: $\vol(tK+(1-t)L)^{1/n}\geq t\vol(K)^{1/n}+(1-t)\vol(L)^{1/n}$.

nodes.name: Alexandrov-Fenchel inequality (classical)
nodes.statement: Cornerstone of mixed-volume theory; equivalent to the statement that the second eigenvalue of $\mathcal{D}_K$ is $\lambda_1=0$ with linear-function eigenfunctions.

nodes.name: Boroczky-Kalantzopoulos symmetric log-BM
nodes.statement: Logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality holds for $K,L$ both symmetric under reflections along the same set of $n$ independent hyperplanes; key tool: simplicial cones and Coxeter group representations.

nodes.name: van Handel zonoid local log-BM
nodes.statement: The local logarithmic Brunn-Minkowski inequality holds when $K$ is a zonoid.

nodes.name: Putterman global-local equivalence
nodes.statement: For $p\in[0,1)$, the $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski inequality is equivalent to the local $L^p$-Brunn-Minkowski inequality (Conjecture 3.8 of Kolesnikov-Milman).

nodes.name: Kubota-type formula
nodes.statement: $\frac{n+1}{\omega_n}V(K^{n+1}[n],\mathbb{D}^n)=\frac{n-1}{\omega_{n-1}}\vol(K)$ for $K^{n+1}\subset\R^{n+1}$ with $h_{K^{n+1}}(x)=\eta(x_{n+1})$.

nodes.name: Center-of-mass condition
nodes.statement: $\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{xh_L(x)}{h_K(x)}dS_K(x)=0$.

nodes.name: Direct sum decomposition $L^2(S^{n-1},\mu_K)=\bigoplus_m E_m$
nodes.statement: $L^2(S^{n-1},\mu_K)=\bigoplus_{m=0}^\infty E_m$ as orthogonal sum of Hilbert spaces, with isometric embedding via Lemma \ref{lemma_Lp}.

nodes.name: Volume identity $\eta(t)-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)(1-t^2)=t\int_0^t\mathcal{A}_2\eta(s)ds$
nodes.statement: For $\eta$ even: $\eta(t)-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)(1-t^2)=t\int_0^t\mathcal{A}_2\eta(s)ds\geq 0$.

nodes.name: Geometric translation interpretation of centering condition
nodes.statement: For any convex body of revolution $K$ and any convex body $L$, there is a translation $\tilde{L}=L+x$ such that $(K,\tilde{L})$ satisfies (\ref{loc_log_bm_ineq}); also a translation that does not.

nodes.name: Bound for $n=2$ in odd case
nodes.statement: For $n=2$ the right-hand side of the odd-case bound is positive for generic odd $\overline{f}\neq 0$, so the technique requires $n\geq 3$. Theorem 4.10 nonetheless holds for $n=2$ via the planar log-BM inequality / van Handel.

nodes.name: Geometric interpretation of $\eta-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(1-t^2)$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)\sqrt{1-t^2}$ is the radius of the circle $C_t=\nu_K^{-1}(\{x_n=t\})$; $\int_0^t\mathcal{A}_2\eta(s)ds$ has a mixed-volume interpretation via the Gauss map.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem A from spectral gap
nodes.statement: Apply spectral inequality to $f=h_L-\frac{\langle h_L,h_K\rangle}{\langle h_K,h_K\rangle}h_K$, identify $\langle\mathcal{D}_Kh_L,h_L\rangle=V(L,L,K[n-2])$ etc., and approximate.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma (zonal Hessian)
nodes.statement: Direct computation by taking the Hessian of the $1$-homogeneous extension $x\mapsto |x|\eta(x_n/|x|)$ and restricting to $T_xS^{n-1}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma (explicit $\mu_K$ and $\mathcal{D}_K$)
nodes.statement: Use the eigenvalues of $D^2h_K$ from Lemma 3.1 to compute $\det(D^2h_K)=\mathcal{A}_2\eta\,\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}$ and apply the mixed-discriminant identities $D(A,\id[n-2])=\frac{1}{n-1}\tr A$.

nodes.name: Proof of $L^p$ identity (Lemma)
nodes.statement: Parametrize $x=(\sqrt{1-t^2}y,t)$, apply Fubini, and use orthonormality of $h_i$ on $S^{n-2}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma (boundary regularity)
nodes.statement: Invert the matrix $(h_i(y_j))$ to express $\overline{f}_i$ via point values of $f$, then use Lipschitz continuity of $f$ at $\pm e_n$ for the Dirichlet bound; differentiate using a vector field $X$ for the Neumann bound.

nodes.name: Proof of explicit form of $\mathcal{D}_m$
nodes.statement: Compute $D^2f$ for $f=\tilde h\tilde f$ via the product Hessian formula, use harmonicity of $h$ to get $\tr D^2\tilde h|_{T_xS^{n-1}}=-m(n+m-2)h$, combine with Lemma 3.1 and Lemma 3.2.

nodes.name: Proof of compact embedding lemma
nodes.statement: (i) approximate by $C^1_c$ to get density; (ii) bound via Cauchy-Schwarz on $\overline{f}(t)=\int_{1-\epsilon}^t\overline{f}'+\overline{f}(1-\epsilon)$ and l'Hospital's rule; (iii) Rellich-Kondrachov on each $[-1+1/N,1-1/N]$ with diagonal sequence and Sobolev embedding for the boundary.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.1 / Lemma 4.3 (even case on $E_0$)
nodes.statement: For $\overline{f}\in C^2[-1,1]$, $f+ch_K$ is the support function of a body of revolution $L$; the symmetric log-BM of Boroczky-Kalantzopoulos applies; the global-to-local implication of Kolesnikov-Milman + the Theorem A computation give the inequality, then extend by density.

nodes.name: Proof of single-eigenfunction lemma
nodes.statement: Rewrite $L_m\overline{f}=\lambda\overline{f}$ as a Fuchsian ODE near $t=\pm 1$; the Frobenius indices are $\alpha_1=0$ and $\alpha_2=-m-(n-3)/2$; the second indicial branch fails the boundary conditions, so weak solutions in $H_m$ form at most a one-dimensional family.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.2 (homotopy)
nodes.statement: Define $\eta_s(t)=1-s+s\eta(t)$ and the gap function $F(s)$; show $F(0)>0$ via Gegenbauer-polynomial eigenfunctions and use Lemma 4.6 (single eigenfunction) plus continuity to rule out $F(1)<0$.

nodes.name: Proof of reduction lemma
nodes.statement: Substitute $\overline{g}(t)=(1-t^2)^{m/2}\overline{f}(t)$; integrate by parts the Sobolev term; verify boundary terms vanish via Lemma 4.4(ii).

nodes.name: Proof of odd-case bound on $E_1$
nodes.statement: Decompose $\overline{f}(t)=(1-t^2)^{-1/2}(t+\overline{g}^\perp(t))$ with $\langle\overline{g}^\perp,t\rangle_{0,n}=0$, apply Lemma 4.7 (reduction) and Theorem 4.2.

nodes.name: Proof of Cauchy-Schwarz odd lemma
nodes.statement: Apply Cauchy-Schwarz then use the geometric inequality $\eta(t)-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(t)(1-t^2)=t\int_0^t\mathcal{A}_2\eta(s)ds\geq 0$ to bound the resulting integral.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.10 (homotopy on $E_1$)
nodes.statement: Lemma 4.11 + Lemma 4.12 give the odd-case bound $\leq -1/(n-1)$; for $s=0$ Gegenbauer polynomials give $F(0)>0$; the homotopy argument as in Theorem 4.2 completes the proof.

nodes.name: Proof of even-case bound on $E_m$ ($m\geq 2$)
nodes.statement: Write $\overline{f}(t)=(1-t^2)^{-m/2}(\eta(t)+\overline{g}^\perp(t))$ with $\langle\overline{g}^\perp,\eta\rangle_{0,n}=0$; same calculation as Lemma 4.11 using Lemma 4.7 and Theorem 4.2.

nodes.name: Proof of Cauchy-Schwarz even lemma
nodes.statement: Cauchy-Schwarz gives a bound involving $\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-1}(1-t^2)^{(n-1)/2}dt$; two integrations by parts plus a Kubota-type identity yield $\frac{n-1}{n}\int\mathcal{A}_2\eta\mathcal{A}_1\eta^{n-2}\eta(1-t^2)^{(n-3)/2}dt$; use $\frac{n-1}{n}<\frac{m(m+n-3)}{n}$ for $m\geq 2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.16 (homotopy on $E_m$)
nodes.statement: Lemma 4.14 + Lemma 4.15 give the even-case bound $\leq -1/(n-1)$; standard homotopy using $L_{m,0}$'s Gegenbauer eigenvalues completes the proof.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.19
nodes.statement: By elliptic regularity $f$ is $C^2$; expand $f=\sum h_i\otimes\overline{f}_i$, verify each $\overline{f}_i\in H_m$ with Neumann BCs (using Lemma 3.4), then apply Theorem 4.10 / Theorem 4.16.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 5.1 (stronger local log-BM)
nodes.statement: Decompose $\tilde f=f-\frac{\langle f,h_K\rangle}{\langle h_K,h_K\rangle}h_K=\sum f_m$; use the parity-restricted bounds from Lemma 4.11/Lemma 4.14 and the Cauchy-Schwarz lemmas plus the inequality $\eta-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(1-t^2)\geq 0$; remove parity by homotopy; approximate by $C^2_+$ bodies.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem B (equality cases)
nodes.statement: Apply Theorem 5.1: equality forces $\int\frac{(\pi_mh_L)^2}{h_K}dS_K=0$ for $m\geq 1$; absolute continuity of $\mathcal{H}^{n-1}$ w.r.t. $S_K$ plus continuity of $\pi_mh_L$ gives $\pi_mh_L=0$ for $m\geq 1$, so $h_L$ is zonal, i.e. $L$ is a body of revolution.

nodes.name: Proof of Symmetrization corollary
nodes.statement: Use orthogonality of $E_m$ in $L^2(S^{n-1},\mu_K)$ to bound $\sum c_m(K)\int(\pi_mh_L)^2/h_K\,dS_K\geq \min\{c_1(K),c_2(K)\}(\int h_L^2/h_K\,dS_K-\int h_{\overline{L}}^2/h_K\,dS_K)$ and plug into Theorem 5.1.

nodes.name: Define $F(s)$ via interpolating $\eta_s=1-s+s\eta$
nodes.statement: $\eta_s(t)=1-s+s\eta(t)$, $L_{0,s}$ the operator $L_0$ defined by $\eta_s$, $F(s)=\sup_{\text{even }\overline{f}\perp\eta_s}\frac{\langle L_{0,s}\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle}{\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle}-\sup_{\text{odd }\overline{f}\perp t}\frac{\langle L_{0,s}\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle}{\langle\overline{f},\overline{f}\rangle}$.

nodes.name: Compute $F(0)>0$ via Gegenbauer polynomials
nodes.statement: For $\eta_0=1$, eigenfunctions of $L_{0,0}$ are Gegenbauer polynomials $C_k^{((n-2)/2)}$ with eigenvalues $\mu_k=1-\frac{k(k+n-2)}{n-1}$; maximizers in (\ref{definition_F(s)}) are $C_2$ (even) and $C_3$ (odd), giving $F(0)=\mu_2-\mu_3>0$.

nodes.name: Contradiction at intermediate $s$
nodes.statement: Continuity of $F$ + assumption $F(1)<0$ would yield some $s$ with $F(s)=0$; this forces two linearly independent solutions to the same eigenvalue equation, contradicting Lemma 4.6.

nodes.name: Decompose $\tilde f$ using projections $f_m=\pi_mf$
nodes.statement: Set $\tilde f=f-\frac{\langle f,h_K\rangle}{\langle h_K,h_K\rangle}h_K=f_0-\frac{\langle f_0,h_K\rangle}{\langle h_K,h_K\rangle}h_K+\sum_{m\geq 1}f_m$ and use Theorem A to get the bound by $\sum_m(\langle\mathcal{D}_mf_m,f_m\rangle+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle f_m,f_m\rangle)$.

nodes.name: Apply parity-restricted bounds with explicit $c_m(K)$
nodes.statement: Under the parity assumption (odd if $m=1$, even if $m\geq 2$), Lemma 4.11 + 4.12 (resp. Lemma 4.14 + 4.15) plus the definition of $c_m(K)$ give $\langle\mathcal{D}_mf_m,f_m\rangle+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle f_m,f_m\rangle\leq -\frac{c_m(K)}{n}\sum_i\int_{S^{n-1}}\frac{h_i^2\overline{f}_i^2}{(1-x_n^2)\mathcal{A}_1(x_n)}dS_K$.

nodes.name: Use $\eta-\mathcal{A}_1\eta(1-t^2)\geq 0$ to replace denominator with $h_K$
nodes.statement: From (\ref{RK-HK_ineq}) we obtain the same estimate with $h_K(x)$ in the denominator: $\langle\mathcal{D}_mf_m,f_m\rangle+\frac{1}{n-1}\langle f_m,f_m\rangle\leq -\frac{c_m(K)}{n}\sum_i\int\frac{h_i^2\overline{f}_i^2}{h_K}dS_K$.

nodes.name: Remove parity assumption via homotopy and approximate
nodes.statement: Same homotopy argument as in Theorem 4.10 / 4.16 removes the parity assumption; finally approximate $K$ by $C^2_+$ bodies (using upper semi-continuity of faces $\Rightarrow$ $\liminf c_m(K_k)\leq c_m(K)$) and apply continuity of $\pi_m$.
